## showMonthYearSelector=False, ❖ Mobile=False
**Node ID:** 36936:6092

Displays 5 calendar weeks.

## [INK] DatePicker
**Node ID:** 36936:6079

Date pickers allow a date or range of dates to be selected. The result is typically passed on to a text field or other input for display.

  

Props
-----

_`**showMonthYearSelector:**`_ displays the month/year selectors on the picker

_`**❖ Mobile:**`_ displays large tap targets

## kind=tertiary, size=medium, ❖ State=default, disabled=false
**Node ID:** 14:1019

When additional clarity is required, an icon can be added alongside text to reinforce an action. If the icon is well-suited to conveying an action on its own, it can appear by itself

## [INK] Icon Button
**Node ID:** 14:953

If the icon is well-suited to conveying an action on its own, it can appear by itself.

  

Props
-----

  

_`**kind:**`_ The kind of the `Button`.

  

_`**❖ State:**`_ The state of the `Button`.

  

_`**disabled:**`_ Applies the 'disabled' attribute.

  

_`**❖ Icon:**`_ The icon to be displayed.

  

_`**badge:**`_ The AlertBadge to be displayed.

**Documentation:**
- [https://ink.docusign.com/94bc5d135/p/241afc-button/t/45206c](https://ink.docusign.com/94bc5d135/p/241afc-button/t/45206c)

## _Blocks / [INK] Digit
**Node ID:** 36936:5174

These individual blocks drive the behavior of the Date Picker component. They should not be used outside of this component.

  

Props
-----

_`**❖ Selected:**`_ Indicates that the `Digit` is selected.

  

_`**❖ State:**`_ The state of the `Digit`

  

_`**❖ Disabled:**`_ Indicates the element is disabled.

  

_`**❖ Current Day**`_: Indicates the current day

  

_`**❖ Null Block**`_: Displays an empty block

  

_`**❖ Date Range**`_: Renders date type range
